summary: Round 3 map edges examined and rejected. (1) STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF with excluded middle to STMT-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-BORROWING-ESCAPE: valid by borrowingEscapeWFEquivalence, but it closes a two-cycle with ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF-FROM-BORROWING-CUT and only restates the recorded equivalence STMT-CONCRETE-BORROWING-CUT-WF-EQUIVALENCE; replaced by the non-circular finite-rank route. (2) STMT-EVERY-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED-AT to STMT-SELECTED-CONE-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED: the proof only instantiates the global premise at cone members (the second half of scopeComparison), an instantiation transcription; replaced by the excluded-middle route from STMT-SELECTED-NO-CONTINGENT-ROOT-ANCESTOR. (3) STMT-COGITO-SOME-THINKING-SUBJECT to STMT-COGITO-THOUGHT-OCCURS: a projection of the existential, and SOME-THINKING-SUBJECT is itself derived from THOUGHT-OCCURS (cycle). (4) STMT-COGITO-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD: from STMT-SELECTED-ACTUAL-CONCRETE it is existential introduction (assembly); every bearer route instantiates STMT-COGITO-BEARER-IS-CONCRETE and STMT-COGITO-BEARER-EXISTS-AT-WORLD at a witness, the shape COGITO-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD already declares an instantiation transcription; a motion route (STMT-SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD with 'whatever is moved is an actual concretum at w0') needs a bridge whose consequent is the conclusion at the witness. Its only gain this round is upstream, through COGITO-THOUGHT-OCCURS-FROM-PERFORMED-DOUBT. Blocker: a typed criterion of concreteness that something about a performed act or occurring episode could satisfy (vocabulary). (5) STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE from a weaker logical floor: constructive logic proves only ¬¬(p ∨ ¬p) (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE-NOT-DENIABLE); excluded middle is independent of it (Kripke/Heyting models, a meta-theoretic fact no finite classical omission model can witness), and the retorsion LOGIC-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE-NOT-DENIABLE excludes denying an instance, not withholding it. (6) Double-negation elimination to STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE: valid and axiom-free (DNE applied to the constructive ¬¬(p ∨ ¬p)), but rejected: equivalent premise; deriving an established floor premise from an equivalent open one de-establishes it in route expansion (the explorer then treats excluded middle as resting on an open premise and stops discharging connections that use it). The derivation and the STMT-DOUBLE-NEGATION-ELIMINATION record were withdrawn from PR #1219. Rejection records that the lead was examined; it neither refutes nor establishes any target.
